title: Overhyped?
body: Idk if these glowing reviews are paid or what - but this app is super glitchy. I had really high hopes for the scanning feature but half the time it can’t even focus properly when you do what the app tells you by filling the cert scan box on the screen- you actually have to hold the slab further back for it to even focus. This was the biggie for me but the whole thing feels like some shaky vibe-coded experiment. Most annoyingly, I had to go through the trouble of creating an account and sharing a phone number just to kick the tires and try scanning. Seems more like a user info grab app more than anything else. Uninstalling for now- provides zero value to me beyond what price charting, ebay, and the psa app already do better, for free! Good luck! This does not hold up to the hype.

title: 2/5 bc that's all that showed up
body: I ordered five different cards from five different sellers. I guess they're maybe still getting things figured out on this app. The scanner is fine. Super fast, super quick. You do have to occasionally double-check cards that are non-English. That's fine. But of the five purchases I made, only two of the cards showed up. All three of the other sellers refunded purchases after I got messages that their listings were incorrect, or the cards had sold somewhere else. Which is just some newbie activity. I believe one seller just refunded the card because the value of the card went up after I purchased it. Just some things that shouldn't happen on this type of app. Hopefully they get some things cleaned up and the best sellers rise to the top.

title: Good app, but missing key buyer features
body: The Double Holo app works well for browsing and selling, but it is missing a major feature for buyers: the ability to easily view and manage bids inside the app. I can find my bids on the website, but not in the iOS app, which means I have to use both instead of relying on the app alone. Right now, the app feels more centered around the selling experience than the buying experience. Buyers need the same level of consideration, especially for core marketplace features like tracking active bids, managing offers, and seeing bid status clearly. I like the idea of the app and want to use it more, but this missing functionality makes the experience feel incomplete.

title: Fun Concept with Big Potential for Serious Collectors
body: As a collector who follows market values and trends closely, I really like what Double Holo is building. The concept is fun, engaging, and captures that same excitement you get from opening packs or chasing cards. The app is clean and easy to use, and it’s great for both casual and newer collectors. That said, adding more market data (recent sales, trends, or grading context) would take it to the next level and make it even more valuable for serious collectors. Overall, strong concept with a lot of potential.
